question: How can even a wise person be affected by the burning force at the tip of nectar?
premises: There is a burning at the tip of nectar.
This occurs through the essence of juice.
Even a wise person is affected.
inference: Even the wise can be burned by the force associated with the tip of nectar and its essence.
uncertainties: The physiological and doctrinal referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are not fully explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
